content.body: The Fairmile B was designed to be a submarine chaser but its design allowed for rapid reconfiguration so that it could fill different roles. Its slow speed compared to other armed water craft limited it to primarily defensive operations, but it is well armed to provide anti-aircraft cover for coastal operations. It also functions well as a gunboat/stealthy commando drop vehicle in coastal and channel island territories.
content.brief: TYPE: Gunboat MAX SPEED: 20 knots WEIGHT: 35.3 tons ARMAMENT: 3 Pdr (47 mm) Vickers Deck Gun (1) 20 mm Oerlikon cannon (1) Dual 20mm AA Battery (1) .303 cal Vickers LMGs (2)
